import numpy as np

def quantize_dequantize(weights, bits=8):
    q_min, q_max = 0, 2**bits - 1
    w_min, w_max = weights.min(), weights.max()
    scale = (w_max - w_min) / (q_max - q_min)
    zero_point = round(-w_min / scale)
    quantized = np.clip(np.round(weights / scale) + zero_point, q_min, q_max)
    dequantized = (quantized - zero_point) * scale
    error = np.mean((weights - dequantized) ** 2)
    return quantized.astype(np.int8), dequantized, error
